results.title: Strawberry: The self-driving browser | Product Hunt
results.content:
#### What's great

The “self-driving browser” idea genuinely feels different from typical AI assistants. I especially liked the ability to watch and guide the agent while it handles repetitive web tasks. Feels like a practical step toward truly autonomous workflows instead of just another chatbot.

#### What needs improvement

Performance can become on heavier worlflows,but the concept and excution are very promising already.

#### vs Alternatives

I liked the balance between automation and human control. Instead of behaving like a hidden AI process, Strawberry makes the workflow visible and interactive, which feels more practical for real-world browsing tasks.
